What is a warm prefix? In LLM inference, prefill is the step of processing the input prompt to compute key/value caches. If the prefix is "warm" meaning it has already been computed/ cached (e.g., from a previous request or system prompt), then the model doesn't need to recompute the K/V states for those tokens; it can reuse the cached prefix states. Thus prefill work is lowered because fewer tokens need to be processed in the prefill stage; the cached prefix can be directly attached.
